notes: *And when* is one rendering of the opening waw, a coordinator and a subordinator written together at the clause's left edge (rule 55); the unit's note records that the corpus heads some *and when* units on *when* instead.
The second waw is unrepresented because the ASV writes no connective for it and the written גַּם takes the *also*; rule 51 is not reached, since a morpheme stands in the clause for that word.
The explicit אַתָּה takes *thou*, so the finite verb keeps only its auxiliaries and lexical verb (rules 17, 20).
